3. **Freedom from the anxious turns of time.** Alongside ordinary doubt in **ر ي ب B001**, **ر ي ب B002** supplies uncertain reversals of time and death. The claim is followed by measured cosmic time (32:5), death and return (32:11), and a fixed day of opening (32:29).
